AList v3 HTTP API. Use the server base URL, optionally including its URL prefix. Use an API token for accounts requiring 2FA, or leave credentials empty for guest access. Credentials are encrypted locally.

Files are transferred through SSH command channels, without SFTP. The server needs a POSIX shell, find, stat (GNU/BusyBox or BSD), cat, wc, mkdir, rm, mv and chmod. Passwords and private keys are encrypted locally.
